Saltwater pool

Open from May to September.

Covered pool

The saltwater pool is gentler on skin and eyes. Thanks to the roof and heat-pump heating, the swimming season is longer than in the reservoir.

  • Open May – September
  • Do not switch off: filtration, water treatment and heating must run continuously, or the water will spoil.
  • Safety: the pool is not fenced but has a sliding cover. Keep it closed when nobody is swimming. When the cover is open, an adult must supervise the pool at all times.
  • Closed from October to April
  • Free for staying guests
